scope: Phase 8 Task 0: periods and currency from the run context. Seven runs (R1-R6, R5b) over the frozen Northbridge pack with every calendar year +1, in USD and EUR.
status: DRAFT by the Phase 8 Task 0 preparer, 2026-11-01; not executed; unreviewed
builder_rule: cases/periods-currency-owner/builder/build.py reads the frozen oracles by value from their pinned files and maps them by four rules; no product code is imported or run
raw_rule: Literal UTF-8 LF, no terminal LF per page; U+000C joins ordered pages for the source SHA256 (same rule as cases/financial/manifest.json)

mapping_rules.years: every 4-digit calendar year +1 in one regex pass over every string and key (2024->2025, 2025->2026, 2026->2027, 2029->2030; the business note's 2011 and 2019 shift too, 'every calendar year')
mapping_rules.period_labels: two-digit labels +1: `LTM Q4 25`, `Q1 25`..`Q4 25`, `FY25`; lower-case structural ids such as `change_vs_fy25`, `total_leverage_fy28` keep their spelling (Phase 8 plan, Decisions: Ids stay)
mapping_rules.currency: EUR runs: `US$` and `USD` -> `EUR`; USD runs keep `US$ m`; amounts are never changed
mapping_rules.digests: every 40+-hex digest -> the sha256 of the shifted source it names (computed here from the shifted bytes)

pages.text:
NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Business and ownership note
Published January 10, 2027.
This invented case is test data, not evidence about a real issuer.
Northbridge Synthetic Group is an industrial products manufacturer. It designs, manufactures and sells fastening and sealing components for industrial equipment.
Customers are industrial distributors that serve maintenance, repair and operations demand, and original-equipment manufacturers supplied under annual supply agreements.
All operations and all reported revenue are in the United States.
Management describes the group as a leading supplier with a resilient aftermarket franchise.
Revenue is reported as one operating segment, Consolidated Operations. The split of revenue between fastening and sealing components, and between distributors and original-equipment manufacturers, is not disclosed.
The share of revenue from the largest customer is not disclosed.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Operating model and ownership
List prices are reviewed once a year. Management states that raw-material cost increases are passed to customers with a lag of one to two quarters.
Volumes follow distributor restocking cycles and original-equipment production schedules.
Cost of sales consists mainly of steel, elastomer and manufacturing labour.
Capital expenditure maintains existing plants; no growth capital programme is under way.
Working capital consists of trade receivables, inventories and trade payables.
The issuer is wholly owned by Harbour Ridge Holdings Limited, a synthetic holding company.
Harbour Ridge Holdings Limited is held by private investors. The identity and percentage holdings of those investors are not disclosed.
The issuer paid a dividend to Harbour Ridge Holdings Limited in each quarter of 2026 under a shareholder distribution policy approved by the board.
No dividend recapitalisation, shareholder loan or related-party payment other than these dividends is reported.
The source set identifies no financial sponsor.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Financing, transactions and history
The only borrowing of the group is the Northbridge Term Loan, a senior secured term loan with final maturity on December 31, 2030.
No acquisition, disposal, new financing, refinancing or change of ownership occurred in 2026, and none is announced or pending as of January 10, 2027.
This note does not describe the security package, guarantees or covenants of the Northbridge Term Loan.
The business was founded in 2012 as a family-owned manufacturer. Harbour Ridge Holdings Limited acquired the group in 2020.
No credit rating from a rating agency has been assigned.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Synthetic executed Northbridge Term Loan covenant terms, current restatement
This invented agreement is test data, not evidence about a real issuer or legal advice.
Execution attestation: the Borrower and all lenders signed this restatement on December 30, 2026. It became effective on December 31, 2026 and remains operative without amendment or waiver through January 10, 2027. All earlier versions of these selected terms are superseded.
Clause 1.1. Borrower means Northbridge Synthetic Group, the issuer named in the Issuer identity and reporting scope note. This separate legal supplement establishes that Borrower only for this agreement; the two-source financial set did not establish a legal borrower, guarantor or restricted-group perimeter.
Clause 1.2. Group means exactly the IFRS consolidated group used in the unaudited quarterly and reported FY2026 financial statements published January 10, 2027. Group is the perimeter for this agreement's debt, cash, EBITDA and leverage test. No separate guarantor or restricted-group perimeter is established by the supplied agreement.
Clause 1.3. The agreement governs Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan, the sole senior secured term loan in the complete facility schedule. Its commitment is USD 50 million; it is fully drawn at December 31, 2026. Final contractual maturity remains December 31, 2030, and mandatory annual amortisation remains zero. This restatement does not increase the commitment or change that maturity.
Clause 1.4. The supplied pages contain the operative leverage test, selected definitions, debt permission and asset-sale condition only. Security enforcement, guarantee coverage, events of default, cure rights, voting and other protections are not supplied; no overall lender-protection conclusion may be inferred from their absence.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Current restatement: definitions and maintenance test
Clause 2.1. Covenant Debt means the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding both finance and operating lease obligations, with no other exclusions or pro-forma adjustments. For the test date all debt is the sole senior secured term loan; no other debt, lease debt or debt adjustment exists.
Clause 2.2. Eligible Cash means the Group's reported cash and cash equivalents that are unrestricted and freely available to service Group debt. At December 31, 2026 all reported cash and cash equivalents are eligible, restricted cash is zero, and there are no short-term investments or other cash-like deductions. Covenant Net Debt means Covenant Debt less Eligible Cash; negative net debt, if any, is not floored at zero.
Clause 2.3. Covenant EBITDA means the Group's reported EBITDA: revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization, over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date. No adjustments, add-backs, synergies, run-rate savings, pro-forma changes or exclusions are permitted. For December 31, 2026 the period is January 1 through December 31, 2026, identical to reported FY2026 and the four discrete calendar 2026 quarters. The underlying statements remain unaudited; this definition supplies no audit assurance.
Clause 3.1. The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2026. The test applies to Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan, whether or not any amount is newly borrowed. The December 31, 2026 test uses closing net debt and trailing twelve-month Covenant EBITDA on the Group perimeter defined in Clause 1.2.

NORTHBRIDGE SYNTHETIC GROUP
Current restatement: selected permissions and source limitations
Clause 4.1. Existing drawings under Northbridge Term Loan are permitted. Additional debt or an increase in that facility's commitment requires prior written consent of every lender. The maintenance leverage limit by itself is not a debt-incurrence permission or an available funding commitment. No additional automatic debt basket is provided by these selected terms.
Clause 5.1. Asset sales must be for fair market value. The Borrower is not required by these selected terms to apply asset-sale proceeds to mandatory debt prepayment, and no asset-sale sweep is provided. This provision does not establish that any asset sale occurred.
Source limitation. These are selected current executed terms, not a complete legal package. Obtain the omitted protections named in Clause 1.4 before rating the overall lender-protection package. Financial statements remain unaudited and consolidated; no borrower-only financial statements, guarantor perimeter or restricted-group financial information are supplied.
